postReview.title: Portugal 1-0 Wales: Joao Felix goal enough to give Jesus winning start
postReview.description: Portugal's first match under Jorge Jesus saw them beat Wales in the Nations League, but they were made to work for Thursday's victory.

preReview.title: Ronaldo motivated by 1,000 goals milestone and leading new Portugal generation
preReview.description: Cristiano Ronaldo hinted at international retirement after Portugal's World Cup exit, but he decided against doing so with more to achieve.

preReview.description: Cristiano Ronaldo dejó entrever que podría retirarse de la selección tras la eliminación de Portugal en el Mundial, pero decidió continuar porque aún tiene objetivos pendientes.
